regions.full_page: "If Artists can be known by their Masterpieces, what better way can there be of learning to know God than by studying His own blessed Immaculate Mother, the Masterpiece of all divine Masterpieces?" Father Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.

regions.full_page: "Dear Reader: To know is to appreciate." Next to the sorrows of Jesus and the inexhaustible Love of His Sacred Heart, the sorrows of Mary and the love that filled her soul, surpass comprehension. At times in the course of the following pages, one can only wonder as at a manifest miracle, the fact that Mary survived the bitter Passion of Jesus. She did survive him for more than fifteen years -- Mother and mistress and Queen ofthe Apostles -- next to Jesus Himself most meek and humble of heart; next to Him also, most compassionate and gentle. Would that Mary were better known! Would that her sorrows were better appreciated! How much better Jesus Himself would then be known! How much better loved! Praised be Jesus and Mary, His Sorrowful Mother!"
